title: Cambodia Travel Essentials
subtitle: Everything you need to research, plan, and explore Cambodia smoothly and safely.
introTitle: Why travelers reliance on this guide
introText: From visa requirements and cultural etiquette to local apps and estimated budgets, this comprehensive guide covers all aspects of traveling in Cambodia.

cards.title: Arrival & Visas
cards.text: E-Visas and Visa-on-Arrival are available ($30-$36). Use the official Cambodia e-Arrival app before landing.

cards.title: Safety & Etiquette
cards.text: Dress modestly at temples (cover shoulders & knees). Respect monks and local customs.

cards.title: Best Time to Visit
cards.text: November to April brings dry, cooler weather—ideal for temples, islands, and outdoor activities.

regions.name: Cultural & Heritage (Siem Reap)
regions.details: Home to Angkor Wat. Pass fees: $37 (1-day), $62 (3-days), $72 (7-days).

regions.name: Capital & History (Phnom Penh)
regions.details: Royal Palace, National Museum, Riverside promenade, and historical landmarks.

regions.name: Coastal & Islands (Sihanoukville, Koh Rong, Kampot, Kep)
regions.details: White sand beaches, island hopping, pepper plantations, and fresh seafood.

regions.name: Eco-Tourism & Nature (Mondulkiri, Ratanakiri, Cardamom)
regions.details: Elephant sanctuaries, jungle trekking, waterfalls, and Indigenous culture.

apps.name: Ride-Hailing:
apps.desc: Grab, PassApp, TADA (easy tuk-tuk & taxi booking)

apps.name: Payments:
apps.desc: Bakong Tourist App, KHQR, Cash (USD & KHR)
